name: Macey Moore
occupation: Converse County commissioner-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Macey Moore is a Converse County commissioner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Robert Short, who is serving through the current term and was elected Wyoming secretary of state in 2026, as reported by the Douglas Budget / WyoRoundup. The same report said Trent Kaufman, Macey Moore, and Cody Torgerson will fill the three open commission seats.

sources.name: Douglas Budget / WyoRoundup, Nov. 3, 2026, Converse County voters pick new leaders in Douglas, Glenrock and Rolling Hills
